prospective_recommendations: Do not change scientific admission, novelty, comparator, reduction, or READY thresholds.
Keep R33 terminal; never rerun, repair, retune, rescore, or upgrade that consumed identity.
Keep candidate #31 terminal with no third rescue; any new protected-set validity or ledger implementation must be a fresh SYSTEM object with fresh prospective authority.
Separate protected-set exposure observability from inferential validity under adaptivity; an exposure ledger is necessary for auditability but is not sufficient evidence of validity.
Before any future protected-set reuse, bind the exact selection-aware or always-valid procedure and machine-check the adaptive choices, stopping process, and assumptions its guarantee covers.

If distributed candidate-selection ancestry cannot be faithfully represented, prefer a fresh independent confirmatory set hidden until candidate/scorer/falsifier binding rather than pretending reuse is auditable.
Do not make fresh splitting universal: a valid prospectively specified reuse regime is acceptable when its assumptions match the actual adaptive process.
Treat protected feedback visibility as a separate control; mask or reduce full protected score trajectories to prospectively allowed minimal signals during candidate generation.

For future scientific PRE_FORMAL, prospectively bind four-stage raw-only generation, durable preserve+digest, fixed scorer exact-blob read, scored-result preservation, protected-set identity, exposure semantics, feedback visibility, and validity regime before result-bearing access.
Preserve intentional idle/no-target behavior when no coherent bounded target exists; check_count is liveness only, not accumulating evidence of absence.
Validate or explicitly map canonical Funnel-v2.1 HOLD enums at producer handoff rather than relying on downstream Analyst normalization.
